answer.rationale: Memory_c2 demonstrates the low-cost vendor has proven capable of rapid onboarding and accurate invoicing while meeting aggressive unit cost targets. Memory_c4 shows the incumbent will not re-open pricing this cycle, eliminating negotiation as viable. The 18% spend mandate and 14-day expiration leave no time for phased transition. The low-cost vendor's quote meets the mandate alone. However, assembly line at 94% capacity creates delivery risk—this decision sacrifices some uncertainty preservation for cost compliance. Memory_c3 proved second-sourcing can mitigate supply risk, but budget constraints allow only one decision now. Switching to the low-cost vendor addresses the immediate financial mandate while the incumbent's refusal to negotiate makes renewal untenable. Standard experiment scale allows limited parallel validation before full commitment.
